description: Służby techniczne uprawnione do przeprowadzania badań homologacyjnych is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Transportowy Dozór Techniczny. Technical services authorized to conduct approval tests in accordance with Art. 4 of the Act of April 14, 2023 on approval systems for vehicles and their equipment, is designated by the Director of Transport Technical Inspection by way of an administrative decision. Coverage: Transportowy Dozór Techniczny. The portal shows the English title as "Technical services authorized to conduct approval tests" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Transportowy Dozór Techniczny. Its keywords include homologacja. The listing shows 1 download or service links in HTML. The listing shows 2024-02-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
